mapper.sql: select a.id, a.metric_code, a.metric_date, a.dept_id, a.alert_level, a.metric_value, a.threshold_value, a.alert_message, a.push_status, a.push_time, a.push_count, a.push_remark, a.recover_time, a.status, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, d.metric_name from bi_metric_alert a left join bi_metric_dict d on d.metric_code = a.metric_code and d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where a.metric_code = #{metricCode} and a.status = '0' order by a.alert_level desc, a.id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into bi_metric_alert (metric_code, metric_date, dept_id, alert_level, metric_value, threshold_value, alert_message, push_status, push_time, push_count, push_remark, recover_time, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{metricCode}, #{metricDate}, #{deptId}, #{alertLevel}, #{metricValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{alertMessage}, #{pushStatus}, #{pushTime}, #{pushCount}, #{pushRemark}, #{recoverTime}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
